name: sa02m-web-build
description: SA-02m web interface repo. There is NO build step — the frontend is served as-is (see docs/agent-rules/sa02m-domain.md). This manifest only exposes dev-only tooling entry points. The Playwright geometry UI-layout driver reuses the existing dev harness's install under scripts/dev (playwright + a downloaded chromium) — playwright is intentionally NOT duplicated as a root devDependency; run `npm run ui-layout:install` to provision it.

scripts.ui-layout:install: npm --prefix scripts/dev install && node scripts/dev/node_modules/playwright/cli.js install chromium
